subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Marine biologist Dr. Margaux Dupont specialized in studying deep-sea bioluminescence techniques during her research in Japan.
• Dupont worked for a research institute that was contracted in 2019 to analyze specimens from the Mariana Trench expedition.
• Most of the organisms discovered in the trench samples exhibited the specific bioluminescence patterns that Dupont had studied.
• At the time, Dupont was not officially listed as lead researcher on the published findings.
• Based on the bioluminescence analysis methods used, marine biologists now believe Dupont conducted most of the specimen research.
prompt: The student wants to specify why marine biologists believe Dupont conducted most of the specimen research. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Though Dupont wasn't officially listed as lead researcher at the time, marine biologists believe she conducted most of the specimen research.
choices.B: Given that most of the specimens exhibited bioluminescence patterns that Dupont had specialized in studying, marine biologists believe Dupont is the one who conducted the research.
choices.C: Most of the Mariana Trench specimens, which were analyzed by an institute Dupont worked for, exhibited specific bioluminescence patterns.
choices.D: Dupont, a marine biologist who specialized in deep-sea bioluminescence techniques, is believed to have conducted most of the specimen research.

explanation:
Choice B is the best answer. The sentence specifies why marine biologists believe Dupont conducted most of the specimen research, noting that most of the specimens exhibited bioluminescence patterns that Dupont had specialized in studying.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect because the sentence emphasizes the bioluminescence patterns of the specimens; it doesn't specify why marine biologists believe Dupont conducted the research.
